outputs.headline: False: 5G mobile towers do not spread the coronavirus
outputs.summary: This claim is false because mobile towers transmit radio signals, whereas the coronavirus spreads through tiny droplets when people cough or sneeze.
outputs.what_post_claims: The post claims that 5G mobile towers spread the coronavirus and caused virus cases to surge in areas where towers were installed.
outputs.what_is_true: 5G networks cannot spread viruses. The coronavirus is a biological virus that spreads between people, and it actively spread across places with no 5G towers at all.
evidence_against: The World Health Organization confirmed that wireless technologies like 5G do not cause or transmit illnesses like COVID-19.
The United Nations stated that wireless signals cannot carry biological viruses, calling the claim a hoax.
Full Fact reported that the virus spread rapidly in many regions that had no 5G networks.
outputs.sources_spoken: the World Health Organization, the United Nations, and AP News
outputs.audio_script: A viral post claims that 5G mobile towers spread the coronavirus and caused local infection spikes. This claim is false. In reality, viruses cannot travel on radio waves or mobile networks. The coronavirus spreads from person to person through respiratory droplets, and it spread quickly in many countries that had no 5G towers at all. We are very sure about this finding. It is supported by global health experts and scientific research from the World Health Organization, the United Nations, and AP News.
card_lines: Reality: Radio waves cannot transmit biological viruses
